request.text: Looking for a Video Editor – Men's Fashion Content. I'm looking for a skilled video editor who can help edit content for social media. Ideally, you should be comfortable with video editing, color grading, pacing, transitions, and creating content that looks clean, polished, and engaging. Bonus points if you have previous experience editing content in the men's fashion / menswear niche. Pay is 5-10 usd depending on experience and skill.

profile.footage: I have raw footage of men's fashion outfits, runway shows, and some behind-the-scenes content. The footage is in 4K and I have about 1-2 hours of material.
profile.story: The video should highlight the latest trends in men's fashion, showcase different outfits, and include some behind-the-scenes moments to make it more engaging. I want to focus on the quality and style of the clothing, and maybe add some text overlays for key points.
profile.purpose: The video will be posted on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. It’s meant to attract followers and potential clients who are interested in men's fashion.
profile.duration: The final video should be around 1-3 minutes long, and I need both vertical and horizontal versions for different platforms.
profile.style: The style should be clean, polished, and modern. The pacing should be fast enough to keep the audience engaged but not too rushed. Smooth transitions and a professional color grade are important.
profile.music_text: I’d like to use upbeat, trendy music that fits the men's fashion vibe. Text overlays for key points and subtitles for any spoken parts would be great.
profile.cover: A dynamic cover image that captures the essence of the video, maybe a stylish outfit or a model in action. It should be eye-catching and representative of the content.
profile.deadline: I need the video within 1-2 weeks from when we start working together.
profile.budget: 5-10 USD per minute of edited video, depending on experience and skill.
profile.ai_policy: I’m open to using AI tools if they can help improve the quality and efficiency of the editing process.
profile.acceptance: The video needs to look professional and engaging. I’ll review it and provide feedback, and we can finalize it once I’m happy with the result.

messages.content: Looking for a Video Editor – Men's Fashion Content. I'm looking for a skilled video editor who can help edit content for social media. Ideally, you should be comfortable with video editing, color grading, pacing, transitions, and creating content that looks clean, polished, and engaging. Bonus points if you have previous experience editing content in the men's fashion / menswear niche. Pay is 5-10 usd depending on experience and skill.

Thanks for sharing! To match you with the right editor and get your project started quickly — could you tell me: what kind of men's fashion content is this? For example: lookbook clips, outfit transitions, behind-the-scenes at a photoshoot, or something else?

[Within 24 hours / In 2–3 days / In 5–7 days / No rush])
I have raw footage of outfits, runway shows, and behind-the-scenes. The final video should be 1-3 minutes long. I need it within 1-2 weeks.

Great — you've got raw footage (outfits, runway, BTS) and want a 1–3 minute final video delivered in 1–2 weeks. To lock in the style and make sure it feels right for men's fashion: what's the *main goal* of this video? For example: showing off new seasonal pieces, building brand identity, highlighting craftsmanship, or something else?
(Quick picks: What's your target final video length? [Under 15 seconds / 15–30 seconds / 30–60 seconds / 60–120 seconds / 120–180 seconds]; Do you have preferences about AI use? [Fine to use AI for rough cuts or auto-captions / Prefer human-only editing (no AI tools) / No preference]; How many rounds of revisions do you expect? [0–1 round / 2 rounds / 3+ rounds])
The main goal is to highlight the latest trends and showcase different outfits. I'm open to using AI tools if they help.

Thanks — highlighting latest trends and outfits is clear. To nail the visual style: do you have any reference videos (e.g., a brand's Instagram Reel, a TikTok creator's fashion edit, or a specific clip you like)? If not, here are three common approaches for men's fashion edits — which feels closest to what you want?
(Quick picks: How many rounds of revisions do you expect? [0–1 round / 2 rounds / 3+ rounds])
I don’t have specific references, but I want it to look clean and modern.

Got it — clean and modern is a great starting point. To translate that into editing choices: which of these three options matches what you mean by 'clean and modern'?
(Quick picks: How many rounds of revisions do you expect? [0–1 round / 2 rounds / 3+ rounds])
You can choose the one that best fits a clean and modern style.

Since you'd like a clean and modern look — here are three concrete options (no vague terms). Which one feels closest to your vision? Also, what's your preference for music and text: do you already have background music or voiceover? Should captions appear? Any specific tone for on-screen text (e.g., minimal sans-serif, bold and punchy, no text at all)?
(Quick picks: How many rounds of revisions do you expect? [0–1 round / 2 rounds / 3+ rounds])
I’d like upbeat, trendy music and text overlays for key points. No specific voiceover.

Got it — your video will be 1–3 minutes, edited from raw outfit/runway/BTS footage, with upbeat trendy music, clean text overlays for key points, and a clean, modern look: no cluttered effects; consistent framing, precise timing, restrained color grading, and intentional use of negative space. Deadline is 1–2 weeks, budget $5–10 USD, and you're open to AI tools for efficiency.
